description: This file defines a PHP class 'LeaveTypeLeaveEntitlementUsageReportData' that implements report data processing for leave entitlement usage in an HRM system. It contains methods for normalizing data, retrieving metadata, and handling leave-related report calculations, leveraging multiple traits and services for data access and formatting.

classes.name: LeaveTypeLeaveEntitlementUsageReportData
classes.description: A class handling report data retrieval and normalization for leave entitlement usage based on leave type, including filtering, formatting, and metadata provisioning.

methods.name: normalize
methods.description: Collects leave entitlement data for employees, formats numeric and date data, and constructs an array representing leave entitlement usage details for reporting.

methods.name: getMeta
methods.description: Provides metadata about the report, including total employee count and normalized leave type info.

methods.name: getNormalizedLeaveType
methods.description: Fetches and normalizes leave type info by leave type ID for inclusion in report metadata.
